mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 43 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park under clear skies and a third quarter moon.
October is officially Community Planning Month, celebrating the department's hard work in helping our city grow, and don't forget that the Beach at Fireman's Park is now closed for the season.
There is plenty to do, including the Dane County Farmers Market today, live music at Paddy Mac's and Lake Lou-ee today, and the World Dairy Expo and Farley Center Fall Festival tomorrow.
In a notable incident on September 19, police and fire crews searched for a 10-year-old child who went missing from Lincoln Street, thankfully locating them safely on North Nine Mound Road.
